stories.title: Gemini 4 Neon
stories.reason: Google's new flagship-tier model; benchmarks include AutoBaxBench 76% and WebExploitBench 51.26% (both SOTA) putting cyber-eval capability in Mine's always-surface lane, plus #1 coding agent index and 0% prompt-injection ASR.
key_facts: $3/M input, $0.15/M cached, $15/M output, 1M context
AutoBaxBench hard tier 76% (SOTA), WebExploitBench v1.2 51.26% (SOTA) at half cost
Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index #1 at 58.6
Gray Swan indirect prompt injection: 0.0% attack success at highest thinking level
32% lower cost per task than Carbon at high thinking level

stories.title: Microsoft’s Agent Framework PyPI package compromised to steal credentials
stories.reason: Confirmed supply-chain compromise of Microsoft's Agent Framework PyPI package to steal credentials — squarely Mine's always-surface AI-supply-chain lane (poisoned package distributing an agent framework).
key_facts: Microsoft's Agent Framework package on PyPI was compromised to exfiltrate developer/cloud credentials

stories.title: LLM assisted reverse engineering
stories.reason: Detailed first-person account of LLM-assisted reverse engineering with a concrete workflow (Ghidra+MCP, hypothesis-debugging skill) and multiple linked repos — running code, not just a claim.
key_facts: Open repos: ioma8/ghidra-decompile-skill, ioma8/hypothesis-debugging, ioma8/neo-re, ioma8/opz-firmware-notes
Six months of RE work: EmWave/Sony Alpha protocol mapping, custom synth firmware, license-lock cracking
Uses DeepSeek for cheap iteration plus Ghidra MCP bridge and radare2

stories.title: European Commission confirms cyberattack, says hackers used AI tool
stories.reason: European Commission confirms an AI-driven cyberattack (CERT-EU ties it to the ARTEX AI hacking platform FBI has warned about) that knocked out payroll/HR systems for 10+ days — direct AI-as-attack-surface story.
key_facts: First signs Oct 22; disrupted payroll, leave, medical reimbursement, translation services for 10+ days
CERT-EU/POLITICO tie it to ARTEX, an open-source AI hacking platform FBI says reaches privileged access in <3 hours
Commission's third disclosed cyber incident this year

stories.title: Unauthenticated remote code execution in Nginx
stories.reason: Two critical unauthenticated RCEs in NGINX's HTTP/2 stack (CVSS 9.2), the world's most-deployed web server (225M+ sites); 1392 HN points means it's already widely seen, but it's large enough to run as a headline per Mine's pure-cyber bar.
key_facts: CVE-2026-123633 (UAF) and CVE-2026-123007 (integer underflow), both CVSS 4.0 9.2
Fixed in 1.30.7 (stable) / 1.31.9 (mainline); Wiz built working PoCs but withheld them
HTTP/2 must be enabled; affects both reverse-proxy and static-file configs

stories.title: Claude solves two open problems in the physics of black holes
stories.reason: Anthropic reports Claude (running as many parallel agent copies, cross-checked and Lean-verified on one result) completed a long-unfinished three-loop SYM calculation and derived a new exact bound on 3D-gravity black-hole mass — a genuine, partly formally-verified math/physics result, though the source is Anthropic's own blog and not independently reviewed.
key_facts: Hawking-Page transition: completed a 2003-era 3-loop N=4 SYM calculation, confirming an abrupt gas-to-black-hole transition
Modular bootstrap: derived exact ceiling M₁ ≤ c/Λ (Λ≈9.1266) on lightest 3D black hole mass; bootstrap result formally verified in Lean
~22 candidate problems proposed by Claude itself, worked by background agents over ~6 weeks; Anthropic's own framing, not peer-reviewed

stories.title: Genie 4 is now available
stories.reason: New flagship-generation release in Google's Genie world-model line; first telling of this release.
key_facts: Genie 4 announced generally available

stories.title: Energy-Based Reasoners: 385x more efficient inference
stories.reason: Energy-Based Reasoners claim 345x less inference compute than the next-best approach on algorithmic reasoning benchmarks (not quite the headlined 385x), with a linked GitHub repo and arXiv paper from a Duke/UIUC/Harvard team.
key_facts: 345x less inference compute vs next-best on Sudoku-Extreme (99.9% acc at 1.8M params)
Energy function over latent reasoning states, no external verifier needed
Code: github.com/wwillchen/ebr; paper arXiv:2611.08977
